name: application-dropdown
title: Dropdowns
description: Responsive dropdown menu components for navigation, filters, settings, and user actions in web applications.
useWhen: Responsive dropdown menu components for navigation, filters, settings, and user actions in web applications.
avoidWhen: Avoid dropdowns when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Dropdowns uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
